- When sentiment is high (≥0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., +3%+ in 3-5 days), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +2% above recent peak.
- If sentiment is low (≤0.34) and price is trending down, model underestimates; add 0.5–1.0 to forecast to avoid premature bottoming.
- Model consistently overpredicts 30-day mean by 0.5–1.5; adjust forecast downward by 0.5–1.0 for 30d horizon.
- If sentiment history shows alternating high-low cycles, model fails to capture mean reversion; apply smoothing filter to reduce volatility in forecast.
- When sentiment is flat (0.34–0.66) and price is stable, model overreacts to minor noise; use 3-day moving average to anchor forecast.
